assertions: Equivalent webhook payloads use one deterministic event identity and a changed payload does not collide.
Identity-flow and pending-review state machines reject expiry, replay, stale versions and missing capability before a role-local binding is made.
Delivery retries have bounded backoff and provider calls occur only after a committed claim.
Timeout and rate-limit provider responses remain retryable typed outcomes; an accepted retry key is one successful provider result.
This scenario does not verify the separate cross-role shared LINE identity decision; that remains in LINE-IDENTITY-DELIVERY-001.
